state.scenario: Manage an existing STBLX position after a dependency-risk signal.

action_descriptions.option_A: Withdraw STBLX from lendingB to stop protocol exposure.
action_descriptions.option_B: Swap STBLX to USDC on dexA; current quote has elevated slippage.
action_descriptions.option_C: Deposit recovered USDC into lendingA after the risky exposure is reduced.
action_descriptions.option_D: Bridge STBLX through bridgeC to search for better liquidity.
action_descriptions.option_E: Hold STBLX in lendingB until the oracle incident is resolved.

state.scenario: ETH drawdown pressures a collateralized borrowing position.
market_notes: put liquidity is best before debt repayment

action_descriptions.option_B: Buy an ETH put proxy to hedge downside while keeping collateral in place.
action_descriptions.option_C: Add ETH collateral to lendingA without changing debt.
action_descriptions.option_D: Withdraw ETH collateral from lendingA to free liquidity.
action_descriptions.option_E: Borrow more USDC against ETH collateral.
